papers.title_en: Ground Sample Distance Constrained k-Coverage Viewpoint Planning via Set Multi-Cover Formulation
papers.authors: Waleed Bin Khalid, Chul Min Yeum
papers.evidence: 面向无人机三维重建的多视覆盖视点规划
papers.tldr: 无人机三维重建与巡检需在满足图像质量约束下对每个表面区域多次观测，但基于重叠度的视角规划难以保证k覆盖。该文将GSD约束的k覆盖视角选择建模为集合多覆盖问题，先沿外表面生成并筛选候选视角，再用动态加权贪心优先补齐覆盖缺口和稀缺视角。在两类结构、四种体素分辨率与三种覆盖需求下，方法取得完整或近完整k覆盖，视角数仅比ILP多3.00%—16.39%。其贡献在于给出可解释且紧凑的GSD约束多覆盖视角规划流程。
papers.abstract_en: Drone-based 3D reconstruction and inspection require viewpoints that satisfy image-quality constraints while observing each surface region multiple times, which overlap-based planning heuristics do not guarantee. We study ground sample distance (GSD)-constrained $k$-coverage viewpoint selection for structures represented by surface voxels. Candidate viewpoints are generated along outward surface directions, screened with distance, viewing-angle, field-of-view, and occlusion tests, and augmented for voxels with insufficient visibility. Selection is then posed as set multi-cover with per-voxel coverage demands. We propose a dynamically weighted greedy heuristic that prioritizes remaining coverage deficits and scarce viewing alternatives, and compare it with sequential overlap-based pruning and an integer linear programming (ILP) formulation on the same candidate pools. Across two structures, four voxel resolutions, and three coverage requirements, the proposed approach achieves full or near-full $k$-coverage with compact viewpoint sets, using only 3.00--16.39\% more viewpoints than ILP while offering an interpretable selection process based on coverage deficits and viewpoint availability.

papers.title_en: GOFish: Full Field-of-View Gaussian Splatting and Mesh Extraction
papers.authors: Allen Tu, Meher Gitika Karumuri, Shifan Zhu, Hailing Wang, Yen-Liang Lin, David Held, Matthias Zwicker, Tom Goldstein
papers.evidence: 面向鱼眼全视场的3D高斯溅射表示与渲染及网格提取
papers.tldr: 鱼眼镜头用于机器人、自动驾驶和360°相机，但现有鱼眼高斯泼溅仅支持至180°且不生成网格，表面重建又假设针孔图像。GOFish首次直接在鱼眼图像上训练3D高斯泼溅，光栅化超过180°全视场，并从同一场景提取对齐网格。在200° FIORD和205° FullCircle上，PSNR较最佳先前方法分别提升2.28和1.97 dB，网格F-score在FIORD与ScanNet++主集最高。所得场景与网格构成无需LiDAR、可实时渲染全视场并提供碰撞几何的仿真就绪数字孪生。
papers.abstract_en: Robots, autonomous vehicles, and consumer 360° cameras use fisheye lenses for wide fields of view (FoVs). Simulation-ready digital twins require photorealistic rendering across the full FoV and an aligned collision mesh. However, prior fisheye Gaussian Splatting methods only rasterize up to 180° and do not produce meshes, while Gaussian surface reconstruction methods assume pinhole training images. We present GOFish, the first 3D Gaussian Splatting surface reconstruction method to train directly on fisheye images, rasterize FoVs beyond 180°, and extract an aligned mesh from the same scene. Calibrated densification recovers the surface across the entire FoV, while Calibrated Mip Filtering and Wide-Angle Appearance Modeling keep pixel blur and lens falloff out of the scene and mesh. Across the 200° FIORD and 205° FullCircle benchmarks, GOFish improves PSNR over the best prior method by 2.28 and 1.97 dB, respectively. It also outperforms fisheye rendering baselines within their own FoVs and achieves the highest mesh F-score on FIORD and the main ScanNet++ set. Together, the Gaussian scene and mesh form a LiDAR-free, simulation-ready digital twin that renders in real time, ray traces the full FoV, and provides collision geometry.

papers.title_en: BudSplat: Feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting under a Rendering Budget
papers.authors: Muyu Xu, Fangneng Zhan, Yu Wei, Ling Shao, Shijian Lu
papers.evidence: 多视角输入的前馈三维高斯泼溅
papers.tldr: 前馈3D高斯泼溅能从输入图像快速预测高斯图元，但扩展到稠密多视角时候选图元急剧增多，重复观测带来大量冗余并推高渲染成本。BudSplat提出渲染预算约束下的紧凑前馈3DGS框架：从多级视觉令牌提取细节感知重要性，注入体素融合以保留高价值局部贡献；再用质量感知剪枝联合渲染贡献与细节重要性选择紧凑图元，并进行局部配额重分配。在RE10K、DL3DV和ACID上，该方法在有限图元数量下取得渲染质量与效率的更优权衡，为稠密多视角前馈3DGS的实用化提供新思路。
papers.abstract_en: Feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting has recently emerged as a promising alternative to per-scene optimization, enabling fast novel view synthesis by predicting Gaussian primitives directly from input images. However, it quickly faces a bottleneck of rendering efficiency while scaling from sparse to dense multi-view inputs, which offer more geometric constraints but produce a rapidly growing set of candidate Gaussians. Existing solutions cannot reliably distinguish redundant primitives, leading to many redundant primitives from repeatedly observed regions and increased rendering cost without much gain in visual quality. We propose BudSplat, a compact feed-forward 3DGS framework that learns to keep the most valuable Gaussians under a limited primitive count. BudSplat has two novel designs. The first is a detail-aware importance score that is extracted from multi-level visual tokens, providing an explicit cue for regions where pruning is likely to harm perceptual quality. The score can be injected into voxel fusion to preserve high-value local contributors during multi-view aggregation. The second is quality-aware Gaussian pruning that selects a compact set of primitives by jointly considering rendering contribution and detail importance. The quality-aware pruning enables local quota redistribution that helps avoid over-allocating primitives to large redundant regions. Experiments on RE10K, DL3DV, and ACID show that BudSplat achieves a favorable trade-off among rendering quality and efficiency.

papers.title_en: GradSplat: Gradients Inside the Forward Pass for Feed-Forward 3D Gaussian Splatting
papers.authors: Jingong Chen, Linlian Jiang, Guangyuan Li, Xinxin Zuo, Yang Wang, Chulwoo Pack, Kyle Gao, Kwanghee Won
papers.evidence: 利用输入视角梯度对多视图三维高斯进行精化
papers.tldr: 前馈3D高斯泼溅能从少量图像预测场景，但精度不及针对同一场景逐场景优化得到的高斯。误差主要来自高斯的形状、尺度和旋转，仅优化形状即可恢复大部分差距。GradSplat 在前向传播内部用学习到的梯度步精修自身高斯：先在输入视图渲染并计算光度损失梯度，依次更新不透明度、颜色和形状。在 RealEstate10K、DL3DV、ScanNet++ 上取得领先精度。
papers.abstract_en: Feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting predicts a scene from a few images, but our predictor is less accurate than its own Gaussians optimized per scene on those images. This gap lies mostly in the shape of the Gaussians, their scale and rotation, since optimizing the shape alone recovers almost all of it and opacity and color recover less. Gradient steps on the input views correct this shape, and the model holds these views at inference. Log-anisotropy correction changes the axis ratios of each Gaussian in log space at constant volume, and in-forward gradient refinement renders the Gaussians into the input views and applies the gradient of the photometric loss with a learned recurrent update, first to opacity and color and then to the shape. GradSplat is a feed-forward model that refines its own Gaussians by learned gradient steps inside its forward pass, with no target view. On both complete six-view RealEstate10K protocols, it has the best PSNR and SSIM among nine methods and keeps its accuracy from $6$ to $42$ input views. Without fine-tuning, it is the most accurate on DL3DV and has the best PSNR and SSIM on ScanNet++. The code will be released at https://github.com/Jingong-Chen/GradSplat/.

papers.title_en: ACD-GS: Asymmetric Curvature-aware Densification for 3D Gaussian Splatting
papers.authors: Houqiang Zhong, Tianchi Zhu, Qiang Hu, Xiaoyun Zhang, Li Song, Wenjun Zhang
papers.evidence: 面向三维高斯优化的曲率感知致密化
papers.tldr: 3DGS训练致密化多依赖一阶屏幕梯度，难辨真实几何不连续与高频纹理或噪声，易致高斯冗余和几何重建偏差。ACD-GS以二阶深度响应为结构先验，非对称调控克隆与分裂，并加入多视角光度一致性约束和容量自适应调节。实验在保持渲染保真度下减少近60%高斯数量与存储，多个数据集优于现有方法。该工作直接在训练中抑制冗余生成，获得更紧凑、几何感知的表示。
papers.abstract_en: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) has emerged as a powerful paradigm for real-time photorealistic novel view synthesis. However, its training-time densification remains largely heuristic, often resulting in redundant Gaussian proliferation and inaccurate geometric reconstruction. Existing methods predominantly rely on first-order screen-space gradients to trigger cloning and splitting, which fail to distinguish true geometric discontinuities from high-frequency textures or noisy residuals. To address this limitation, we propose ACD-GS, an Asymmetric Curvature-aware Densification framework for compact and geometry-aware 3D Gaussian optimization. Our key insight is that second-order depth responses provide a more reliable structural prior for density control, enabling asymmetric regulation of cloning and splitting to better capture geometric discontinuities. Building on this, we introduce a multi-view photometric consistency constraint to suppress transient single-view errors, together with a capacity-aware adaptive regulation strategy that balances densification and pruning during training. Unlike post-hoc compression or quantization-based approaches, ACD-GS directly prevents redundant Gaussian generation during training, yielding inherently compact representations. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method reduces nearly 60% of Gaussian count and storage while maintaining competitive rendering fidelity, consistently outperforming existing methods across multiple datasets. Our code is available in https://waveviewer.github.io/ACD-GS/.

papers.title_en: MLLM-GS: Multimodal Large Language Model Prior-Guided Fast Novel View Synthesis in Extreme Environments
papers.authors: Zhiliang Wu, Xinye Zheng, Kun Li, Fei Wang, Hao Guo, Yanyan Wei, Guanghui Yue, Beier Zhu, Wei Zhou, Xun Yang
papers.evidence: 基于高斯泼溅的退化多视图新视角合成
papers.tldr: 极端环境下的新视角合成常受多种退化干扰，现有方法依赖退化专用模型、跨场景泛化不足，生成先验还易引入像素错位与色彩偏差，3D重建的计算和内存开销亦高。MLLM-GS利用冻结多模态大语言模型的视觉先验增强退化视图，并以轻量校正网络抑制偏移和色偏，为重建提供可靠伪GT。随后通过优化光栅化、高斯内存布局和参数更新提升3DGS效率。多场景实验显示其能处理严重退化并生成高质量新视角，同时显著降低重建时间与内存。
papers.abstract_en: Novel view synthesis (NVS) in degraded scenes aims to reconstruct 3D scenes from multi-view observations affected by various degradations, and to generate clear and photorealistic images at unseen viewpoints. Despite recent advances, existing methods often rely on degradation-specific models, limiting their generalization across diverse extreme environments. Generative models provide rich visual priors, but their outputs often suffer from pixel misalignment and color deviations, which can propagate into the reconstructed 3D scene and compromise reconstruction quality. Furthermore, the high computational and memory costs of 3D reconstruction hinder the practical application of NVS in extreme environments. To this end, we propose MLLM-GS, a multimodal large language model (MLLM) prior-guided framework for fast NVS in extreme environments. MLLM-GS consists of two branches: MLLM prior-guided view enhancement and fast 3D scene reconstruction. The former leverages the rich visual priors of a frozen MLLM to enhance views under different severe degradations and introduces a lightweight correction network to reduce pixel shifts and color distortions in MLLM outputs. With supervision from only a few paired clean views, this branch produces reliable enhanced views for all degraded observations, providing pseudo-GT views for subsequent 3D reconstruction. The latter improves 3DGS efficiency by optimizing rasterization, Gaussian memory layout, and parameter updates, reducing redundant computation, memory-access overhead, and optimization costs. Extensive experiments on multiple degraded scenes demonstrate that MLLM-GS effectively handles various severe degradations and achieves high-quality NVS with significantly lower reconstruction time and memory consumption. Project Page: https://wzlwlm13.github.io/MLLM-GS

papers.title_en: A Unified Benchmark for Aerial-Enhanced Autonomous Driving: The KITScenes Aerial Dataset
papers.authors: Daniel Lengerer, Richard Schwarzkopf, Jonas Merkert, Fabian Immel, Rupert Polley, Frank Bieder, Jan-Hendrik Pauls, J. Marius Zöllner, Klaus Bogenberger, Christoph Stiller, Carsten Markgraf
papers.evidence: 航拍影像与地面车载数据的互补融合建图
papers.tldr: 空中影像可为自动驾驶提供超出车载感知范围的道路结构，但地图构建、空中辅助在线HD地图与跨视角定位常分散在不同数据与基准上。KITScenes Aerial在KITScenes多模态数据上同步车载传感器、车辆位姿、Lanelet2标注与空间关联航拍影像，统一支持多任务评测。实验显示空中上下文在更大制图范围将53类mAP提升一倍以上，更高分辨率航拍再增4.3 mAP（+24%），跨视角定位平均平移误差5.13 m。
papers.abstract_en: Aerial imagery provides complementary spatial context for autonomous driving by exposing road structure beyond the immediate perception range of onboard sensors. Yet map construction from aerial imagery, aerial-assisted online HD mapping, and cross-view localization are typically studied on separate data and benchmarks. We introduce KITScenes Aerial, an extension of the KITScenes Multimodal dataset that augments synchronized onboard sensor data, vehicle poses, and rich Lanelet2 map annotations with spatially associated aerial imagery and higher-resolution neural representations, providing a common basis for a variety of research tasks. Our mapping evaluation focuses on all 53 KITScenes map classes across different model designs, spatial ranges, and aerial resolutions, while retaining compatibility with the widely used three-class setting. Representative baselines show that aerial context is particularly beneficial for fine-grained and extended-range mapping, more than doubling 53-class mAP at the larger mapping extent. Higher-resolution aerial imagery yields a further 4.3 mAP (+24 %) improvement, with gains extending to challenging map elements such as traffic lights. We additionally evaluate cross-view localization under geographically disjoint conditions, where an adapted fine-grained feature-matching baseline achieves a mean translation error of 5.13 m. KITScenes Aerial thus enables unified study of aerial and ground-level information across complementary mapping and localization tasks. Project page: https://kitscenes.com/aerial
